name: chatgpt-dsh-bridge
description: Dispatches local coding tasks from ChatGPT to DeepSeek Harness (DSH) over a local STDIO MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Plan and review coding tasks in ChatGPT or Codex, then run them through DeepSeek Harness on Windows. Every task is restricted to a locally configured project allowlist. Read-only is the default; writes require a signed grant for the exact project directory.
defaultPrompt: Check the local DSH bridge health with dsh_health_check.
Use DSH to inspect this project in read-only mode and summarize its test setup.
Plan the fix with me first; do not start a write task until I explicitly approve it locally.
